status: Verified declarations in pinned recovered source. Retail playback speed, build guards, ability reachability and actual shipped assets require independent build observations.

field_semantics.source_frame_count: Number of sprite frames declared for a sequence. This is neither elapsed milliseconds nor a suggested keyframe count for a new model.
field_semantics.per_direction_stride: Index increment between sprite directions. Zero means the index does not advance with facing.
field_semantics.constructor_standing_prone_launch_marker: Compiler parameter values for standing/prone projectile release. Meaningful only for an applicable armed action. One-frame or zero-frame declarations cannot prove any ability.
field_semantics.source_marks_not_applicable: Based on inline NA/N/A comments. Some unsupported states still have nonzero placeholder indices.
